campaign.note: 16 bars at 88 bpm, repetition 0.97 / seam 0.98, beat tracker agrees with 88-89 bpm, no gaps.

victory.note: Lands on the home chord most clearly (D major triad 0.73 of the last 1.5 s, tonic on top); the final chord rings and decays (-9 dB vs the phrase).
Equally clear landing (0.73) and a fuller held end (-5 dB), but a slightly harsher top (2-6 kHz share 0.033 vs 0.02-0.03).
Holds the end best (-3 dB) but the last chord is less clearly the home triad (0.38).

defeat.note: Lands on the D minor home chord (0.62, tonic on top) and holds it; 5.8 s.
